title: Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP)
overview: The Agile Certified Practitioner (PMI-ACP) course provides comprehensive training on Agile principles, practices, and methodologies. It is designed for professionals who are looking to enhance their knowledge and skills in Agile project management and demonstrate their ability to apply Agile practices effectively in various project environments.
audience: Project managers and team leaders involved in Agile projects.
Professionals seeking to advance their career in Agile project management.
Scrum Masters, Product Owners, and Agile Coaches.
Individuals preparing for the PMI-ACP certification exam.
methodology: Lectures and Presentations: In-depth explanations of Agile methodologies and practices.
Hands-On Labs: Practical exercises and simulations to apply Agile principles in real-world scenarios.
Case Studies: Analysis of Agile projects to understand best practices and common challenges.
Group Discussions: Interactive sessions to explore Agile concepts and experiences.
Quizzes and Practice Exams: Assessments to evaluate understanding and readiness for the certification exam.
competencies: Agile principles and frameworks (Scrum, Kanban, Lean, XP)
Agile project management practices and tools
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: To provide a thorough understanding of Agile principles, methodologies, and practices.
To develop skills in applying Agile techniques to manage and deliver projects effectively.
To prepare participants for the PMI-ACP certification exam.
To equip participants with knowledge to lead Agile teams and manage Agile projects.
